additions.distinctness_review: The address, project names and planning identifiers were checked against prior sites, projects, evidence and source records. The nearest prior site is Dover South Morang SM1B, 16.5 km away.

locator.identity_review: The sponsor and federal consultation identify the same 45 Donnybrook Road development. The official address identifier connects directly to the selected Vicmap property.
locator.method: Area centroid of property 425177331 computed in GDA2020 / MGA zone 55 (EPSG:7855), transformed to WGS 84 and checked inside the property.
locator.precision: Representative point on the property at 45 Donnybrook Road. The individual proposed building positions are unverified.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral data gives no surveyed positional uncertainty for this representative point.

additions.name: AirTrunk MEL3 Mickleham Data Centre — proposed campus

roles.party: AirTrunk MEL3 Pty Ltd as trustee for AirTrunk MEL3 Land Trust

status.summary: On November 9, AirTrunk presented its proposed data center campus at 45 Donnybrook Road in Mickleham.

additions.successor_review: The sponsor described a proposal subject to approvals. The federal comment window closed on November 18. No grant of development consent or commencement of works was identified.

additions.distinctness_review: The address, project names and planning identifiers were checked against prior sites, projects, evidence and source records. The nearest prior site is AirTrunk Kurri Kurri Data Centre, 52.2 km away.

locator.identity_review: NSW’s issued assessment requirements match the applicant’s scoping report on both civic addresses and both cadastral lots. The selected lot is the main 12.22-hectare site parcel identified by the applicant.
locator.method: Area centroid of Lot 703//DP1275094 computed in GDA2020 / MGA zone 56 (EPSG:7856), transformed to WGS 84 and checked inside the property.
locator.precision: Representative point on the main development parcel at 30 Lucca Road. A smaller second lot also forms part of the application.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral data gives no surveyed positional uncertainty for this representative point.

additions.name: Lucca Road Data Centre, Wyong — proposed campus

status.summary: On November 13, Central Coast Council reviewed the proposed Lucca Road Data Centre at 30 Lucca Road and 1 Pavitt Crescent, Wyong, as part of the state assessment.

additions.successor_review: The NSW register lists preparation of an environmental impact statement. Council advice considers the proposal in assessment. The record remains at the proposal stage.

additions.distinctness_review: The address, project names and planning identifiers were checked against prior sites, projects, evidence and source records. The nearest prior site is CDC Eastern Creek Campus, 0.3 km away. NSW’s separate approval SSD-10330 puts CDC’s project at 17 Roberts Road on Lot 2 DP1159804. Goodman’s site is 10 Roberts Road on Lot 553 DP1110447.

locator.identity_review: The case reference in the current request for further information matches NSW’s planning requirements identifying Lot 553 DP1110447 at 10 Roberts Road. The independent cadastral record reproduces that legal lot.
locator.method: Area centroid of Lot 553//DP1110447 computed in GDA2020 / MGA zone 56 (EPSG:7856), transformed to WGS 84 and checked inside the property.
locator.precision: Representative point inside the 10 Roberts Road development parcel. The proposed building locations have not been separately delineated.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral data gives no surveyed positional uncertainty for this representative point.

additions.name: Goodman Project Atlas Data Centre, Eastern Creek — proposed campus
additions.site_name: Goodman Project Atlas Data Centre, Eastern Creek

status.summary: On November 13, the NSW planning department requested further information from Goodman on its pending application for Project Atlas Data Centre at Eastern Creek.

additions.successor_review: The department sought further information during assessment. The public register continues to identify the application as under assessment.

additions.distinctness_review: The property at Goethering 29 in Offenbach differs from maincubes FRA03 in Schwalbach am Taunus and NorthC Frankfurt1, which also uses the code FRA01. The nearest existing atlas site is Digital Realty Digital Park Ostend across the municipal boundary in Frankfurt.

locator.identity_review: The FRA01 operator sheet gives Goethering 29, postcode 63067. The Hessen address feature gives house number 29 and links to the Goethering street and Offenbach am Main municipality records.
locator.method: Use the Hessen cadastral house coordinate for Goethering 29 in Offenbach am Main.
locator.precision: Official numbered address on the FRA01 property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address feature gives no measured positional error for this individual house coordinate.

additions.name: maincubes FRA01 — existing operations

status.summary: On November 12 Prepaid-Host named maincubes FRA01 as one of two locations for its Frankfurt hosting service and said it could provision the service immediately.

additions.successor_review: The operator continues to list FRA01 in operation. Its customer identifies NTT FRA02 as an additional location and continues to list maincubes FRA01 separately.

additions.distinctness_review: Property-specific aliases were absent from six baseline layers. The nearest existing property is ODATA DC QR02 Campus (Parque Industrial Amexhe, Guanajuato), 294502 metres away. The EPI address and the Jalisco public record identify Astral Plaza within the hotel. The operator’s other commercial contact addresses do not identify the certified property.

locator.identity_review: The EPI address and the Jalisco public record identify Astral Plaza within the hotel. The operator’s other commercial contact addresses do not identify the certified property.
locator.precision: Representative point for the shared Astral Plaza and Hotel Presidente InterContinental property. Assetel occupies part of the building.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The mapped commercial-property polygon has no published numerical positional accuracy.

additions.name: Assetel Astral Plaza — certified facility

status.summary: EPI renewed its constructed-facility certification on October 5, 2026 for Assetel’s data center at Astral Plaza. Its initial certification dates to 2020.

additions.successor_review: The same property and certified entity appear in the current constructed-facility registry and the separately reviewed commercial sources.

additions.distinctness_review: Property-specific aliases were absent from six baseline layers. The nearest existing property is Equinix MO1, Calle Aristóteles 119 Nave 6, Apodaca, 2671 metres away. EPI and BSI give Libramiento Norte 111 in Apodaca. OpenStreetMap independently names the commercial campus. The existing Triara Querétaro facility has a different address and municipality.

locator.precision: Representative point for the Triara Monterrey commercial campus in Apodaca. The certified portion of Phase IV is located only to campus precision.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The mapped commercial-property polygon has no published numerical positional accuracy.
